items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: On this particular album, he has Bobby, Vic and Maxine. And there's some selections featuring Bobby, and some featuring Vic.

ctx.x: Which gives it a nice touch.

It's always a pleasure to work with Bobby. And as I said before, these things -- they're recorded and you don't know how Fat Cat is going to put them out. On this particular album, he has Bobby, Vic and Maxine. And there's some selections featuring Bobby, and some featuring Vic. And I've got -- well five out of ten of these selections are vocals with me doing the vocals. And I said earlier, also, that you're not working with same group all the time when you're doing a festival. And there is a possibility that…
